messages:
nora: Heads-up: during final preflight for private-vpc installer v1.5.0-rc2 we spotted a tarball ETag mismatch between registry and offsite mirror. Holding cutover. @deploy-bot hold any active canaries and stop new rollouts.
jamal: Which file? `redwood-private-vpc-20260321.tar.gz`?
pat-packaging: Yep. Registry ETag: ght789... mirror ETag: ght000... sizes differ by ~1.2MB. Cosign sig exists.
ops-ania: If cosign sig exists but blobs differ, it's likely a partial mirror push. We'll block outbound transport and notify carriers.
sre-oncall: @deploy-bot status please and blocklist mirror-offsite-2 if needed.
deploy-bot: [DEPLOY-BOT] Pause request received for 1751234567. Active canaries: canary-1751234000 (7%), canary-1751234101 (3%). Pausing further rollouts. Blocking new canaries. Recording incident: INC-2026-031.
pat-packaging: Quick triage plan: a) verify local artifact sha256 b) check cosign payload vs manifest c) list mirrors with mismatched size.
nora: I'll run `sha256sum` and `cosign verify-blob`.
jamal: Don't re-sign yet. If mirror is bad, fixing mirror (atomic rename) is enough. Re-signing changes tag and will force downstream re-downloads.
pat-packaging: Running checks now...
pat-packaging: local sha256 = 9f1b2c... matches registry shrinkwrap. Mirror-offsite-2 has older size and older ETag. Mirror-us-1 and mirror-eu-1 are fine.
ops-ania: Action: quarantine mirror-offsite-2 from origin pool, switch CDN origin to mirror-us-1, purge object `redwood-private-vpc-20260321.tar.gz`.
deploy-bot: [DEPLOY-BOT] Commands executed: set-origin-priority --origin mirror-us-1; quarantine-mirror mirror-offsite-2 --reason 'mismatched-etag'; purge-cdn /artifacts/redwood-private-vpc-20260321.tar.gz -> OK.
sre-oncall: I'll add a one-off synthetic monitor: artifact-download-success for mirror-us-1 >= 99.95% for 20min before we resume.
jamal: Also add integrity check on mirror-side: when pushing, write to tmp and atomic mv into place. We need a packaging change to enforce this.
pat-packaging: I can patch pipeline, but it's a quick change to uploader. Will open a patch and run a targeted push to mirror-offsite-2 with tmp file + rename, then verify checksum.
ora: Ops, timeline? If mirror cannot be fixed within 90 minutes, we escalate to rolling back the release pointer to v1.4.9 (current stable) for safety?
ops-ania: We prefer to avoid rollback unless customers have pulled corrupted artifacts. Plan: hold up to 3 hours. Notify CS at 30m and 1h marks. If >3h, engage vendor transport and consider rollback.
pat-packaging: Pushing new copy to mirror-offsite-2 using atomic rename now. Upload in progress...
pat-packaging: Push complete. Calculated sha256 on mirror-offsite-2 matches registry.
ops-ania: Mirror health check shows good. Unquarantining mirror-offsite-2.
deploy-bot: [DEPLOY-BOT] mirror-unquarantine mirror-offsite-2 -> success.
sre-oncall: Purging CDN again and warming from mirror-us-1 as origin for 10m.
pat-packaging: Verified cosign verify-blob OK against signed-manifest; signatures valid and payload hash equals registry shrinkwrap. No re-sign needed.
jamal: Great. Now we need to decide deploy flow: auto-resume or manual gate? I vote manual resume and a staged canary: 5% for 20m, then 15% for 20m, then ramp.
ora: agreed manual. @deploy-bot set resume-mode=manual for thread 1751234567 and do not auto-rollback.
deploy-bot: [DEPLOY-BOT] resume-mode set to manual. Auto-rollback disabled. Awaiting manual resume command.
ops-ania: I'll draft a short customer advisory in #customer-success stating brief delay and that artifacts validated; will send only if delay exceeds 30m.
sre-oncall: Starting download monitor now. Current download success on mirror-us-1: 100% last 5m.
pat-packaging: PR created to pipeline: uploader writes to `<name>.tmp` then `mv` into place; also added post-push sha256 verification and cosign re-check. PR #1288.
ora: Manual resume issued by me once monitors are green. Starting 5% canary now.
deploy-bot: [DEPLOY-BOT] Manual resume received: `deploy-bot resume --thread 1751234567 --by nora`. Creating canary canary-1751234700 at 5%.
sre-oncall: Canary started. Observability: downloads OK, no integrity errors, latency steady.
ops-ania: Holding on CS advisory. If canary stays clean for 25m we'll continue ramp.
jamal: Add a playback test: install from artifact and run basic smoke script as part of canary.
pat-packaging: Smoke test passed on canary nodes.
nora: After 25m green, ramp to 15% then full. Leaving thread open for final signoff.
deploy-bot: [DEPLOY-BOT] Canary timers set: 25m first window, then 30m second. Notifications will post on completion.
pat-packaging: After action items: 1) uploader atomic mv 2) mirror validation step 3) update runbook to suspend origin promotion until cosign finalization.
ora: Thanks team. Will mark incident INC-2026-031 as resolved after full ramp plus 1h stable. :white_check_mark:
